content_zh:
玄天宗，练剑峰。
空旷的山地上，数十名白衣少年在练剑，炫目的灵力包裹着长剑，剑锋划破空气，在空中震荡不止。
不远处，一群麻衣少年痴痴地望着，眼中满是羡慕之色。
“我要是能成为他们中的一员就好了，那样我也能学剑练剑，想想就激动！”
一麻衣少年说道。
“做梦吧！
人家是玄天宗弟子，而我们是剑奴，怎么可能和他们一样练剑！”
“想成为玄天宗弟子，简单啊，学林轩就行了！”
一道阴阳怪气的声音响起。
众麻衣少年笑成一团，目光却都望向了同一个地方。
在树林间，有一个麻衣少年，大约十六七岁，脸庞清秀，身子有些单薄，他拿着一柄黑铁长剑，不断的刺出。
汗水早已打湿了他的衣衫，可他却浑然不知。
“林轩？哼，就他这种废物，给他一百年他都成不了玄天宗弟子！
别的不说，在我们之中，他就是垫底的，拿什么去成为玄剑宗弟子？”
“对啊，我听说前些日子他想冲击凝脉境，结果失败，吐血不止，修为更是掉到了炼体三阶，到现在还没恢复呢！”
这声音之中充满了幸灾乐祸的味道。
“就他，这三个月天天都练同一招剑法，而且还是平淡无奇的那种，估计他都练傻了！”
不少人的声音都很大，林轩听到这些话，心中泛起一丝苦涩，但是握剑的手更加用力了，他绷着一张小脸，继续练剑。
武道一途，炼体是基础，而凝脉境才算是入门，只有打通体内灵脉，才有机会在武道之路上走的更远。
“王哥已经是炼体九阶了吧，要是突破到凝脉境，可不要忘了我们啊！”

这些麻衣少年看到林轩不为所动，纷纷暗骂一句，然后开始讨好身边的一位少年。
“那肯定的，王哥再有两个月就能突破了，到时候也许能成为玄天宗弟子也说不定呢！”
王洋不屑的瞟了一眼林轩，这才说道：“用不了两个月，最多一个月，我就能突破！”
“真的啊？王哥威武……”
身边的这些麻衣少年纷纷拍起马屁。
“王哥，你看那林轩多么嚣张，不如您教训教训他。”
王洋心中早就对林轩不满，他看了一眼练剑的白衣弟子们，估摸着离休息的时间还长，这才起身朝着林轩走去。
众麻衣少年纷纷跟上，准备看林轩的笑话。
林轩全神练剑，他身子前冲，手中长剑直刺而去，剑光一闪，树干上留下了一道剑痕。
其实他们不知道，林轩这一招已经练习三年了。
从那一天起，他每天都练这一招剑法，无论什么情况，他都没有停止过。
嗖！
一个石子飞向林轩的后脑，响起破空之声，力道之狠，让人心惊。
林轩身子一倾，险而又险的避过了这一击，他停下身子，有些愤怒的望去。
只见王洋带着一群麻衣少年站在不远处，一副要找事的样子。
“呦，身法不错啊，这都能躲过？”
那王洋笑嘻嘻的说道。
content_en:
Xuantian Sect, Sword Practicing Peak.
On the empty mountain ground, dozens of young men in white were practicing sword practice. The swords were wrapped in dazzling spiritual power. The sword blades cut through the air and vibrated in the air.
Not far away, a group of young men in linen clothes looked at them dreamily, their eyes full of envy.
"It would be great if I could become one of them. Then I could also learn and practice swordsmanship. It makes me excited just thinking about it!"
Said a boy in linen clothes.
"Dream!
They are disciples of Xuantian Sect, and we are sword slaves. How can we practice swordsmanship like them! "
"If you want to become a disciple of Xuantian Sect, it's easy, just learn from Lin Xuan!"
A strange voice sounded.
All the boys in sackcloth laughed together, but their eyes were all looking at the same place.
In the woods, there was a young man in linen clothes, about sixteen or seventeen years old, with a handsome face and a somewhat thin body. He was holding a black iron long sword and stabbing it out continuously.
Sweat had already wet his clothes, but he didn't even know it.
"Lin Xuan? Humph, for a waste like him, even if you give him a hundred years, he won't be able to become a disciple of the Xuantian Sect!
Apart from anything else, he is the bottom among us, so why should he become a disciple of Xuanjian Sect? "
"Yes, I heard that he tried to attack the Pulse Condensation Realm a few days ago, but failed. He vomited blood and his cultivation level dropped to the third level of body refining. He has not recovered yet!"
This voice was full of schadenfreude.
"He's been practicing the same swordsmanship every day for the past three months, and it's still an ordinary swordsmanship. He's probably gone crazy from practicing!"
Many people's voices were very loud. When Lin Xuan heard these words, he felt a bit bitter in his heart, but his hand holding the sword was harder. He kept a straight face and continued to practice the sword.
On the way to martial arts, body training is the foundation, and the pulse condensation realm is the entry point. Only by opening up the spiritual veins in the body can one have the opportunity to go further on the road to martial arts.
"Brother Wang is already at the ninth level of body refining. If you break through to the pulse condensation realm, don't forget us!"
Seeing that Lin Xuan was unmoved, these young men in sackcloth cursed secretly, and then began to please a young man next to them.
"That's for sure. Brother Wang will be able to break through in two months, and maybe he can become a disciple of the Xuantian Sect by then!"
Wang Yang glanced at Lin Xuan disdainfully, and then said: "In less than two months, at most a month, I will be able to break through!"
"Really? Brother Wang is so powerful..."
The boys in sackcloth around him began to flatter him one after another.
"Brother Wang, look at how arrogant Lin Xuan is, why don't you teach him a lesson?"
Wang Yang had long been dissatisfied with Lin Xuan in his heart. He glanced at the white-clothed disciples who were practicing swordsmanship, and estimated that there was still a long time to rest before he got up and walked towards Lin Xuan.
All the boys in sackcloth followed suit, ready to see Lin Xuan's joke.
Lin Xuan concentrated on practicing his sword. He rushed forward and stabbed straight with the long sword in his hand. The sword light flashed and left a sword mark on the tree trunk.
In fact, they didn't know that Lin Xuan had been practicing this move for three years.
From that day on, he practiced this sword technique every day, no matter what the situation, he never stopped.
Whoosh!
A stone flew towards the back of Lin Xuan's head, and the sound of breaking through the air was heard. The force was so cruel that it was shocking.
Lin Xuan leaned forward and narrowly avoided the blow. He stopped and looked angrily.
I saw Wang Yang standing not far away with a group of boys in sackcloth, looking like they were looking for trouble.
"Hey, your body skills are pretty good. Can you dodge this?"
Wang Yang said with a smile.
